title: Asymptotic majority rationality probability
statement: For each $k\ge 0$, choose a profile of $2k+1$ voters independently and uniformly from the six strict rankings of three alternatives. Each of the three pairwise elections is decided by majority. As $k\to\infty$, the probability that the three majority outcomes are not all equal converges to $\frac34+\frac{3}{2\pi}\arcsin\!\left(\frac13\right)$.
hypotheses_covered: Each voter is assigned one of six rankings
Profiles are sampled from the uniform distribution on profiles
